topic: Asking for an OTC Cold Remedy

script.title: ASKING FOR AN OTC COLD REMEDY
script.story_hook: Asking the pharmacist for a cold remedy.
script.intro_zh: 向藥師詢問一款適合白天的感冒藥。
script.welcome_en: Hey friends, welcome back! Today we're buying cold medicine.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，歡迎回來！今天我們來買感冒藥。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep listening and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續聆聽，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a sniffly young woman in her twenties with long straight black hair in a loose braid, wearing an oversized lavender sweater and denim leggings, holding a tissue in one hand
script.char_b_description: a careful pharmacist in his forties with salt-and-pepper short hair and thin glasses, wearing a light blue shirt under a white coat, writing on a small label pad

script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🤧感冒用藥英文｜描述症狀・挑不嗜睡・確認交互作用｜聽完就會問｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
感冒了，卻不知道該買哪種藥？
白天又不能嗜睡，用英文到底要怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進一家藥局，跟著病人從描述症狀、要求白天不嗜睡，到確認與既存藥物的交互作用，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🤧 描述症狀：例如「a stuffy nose all week」、「sore throat, and I feel tired」。
🌞 挑不嗜睡：例如「non-drowsy for daytime」、「avoid the night formula」。
⚠️ 確認交互作用：例如「let me check for any interactions」、「space them out」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來買感冒藥可以這麼簡單！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've had a stuffy nose all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪv həd ə ˈstʌfi noʊz ɔl wik/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry to hear that. Anything else?
dialogue.zh: 很遺憾聽你說。還有別的症狀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sore throat, and I feel tired by noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔr θroʊt ənd aɪ fil ˈtaɪrd baɪ nun/
dialogue.zh: 喉嚨痛，而且中午就開始累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Need something non-drowsy for daytime?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt nid ˈsʌmθɪŋ nɑn ˈdraʊzi fɔr ˈdeɪtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 了解。你需要白天不嗜睡的藥？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I drive for work, so no drowsy ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ draɪv fɔr wɜrk soʊ noʊ ˈdraʊzi wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 要的，我開車上班，所以不能嗜睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then avoid the night formula, it sedates.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn əˈvɔɪ ðə naɪt ˈfɔrmjələ ɪt səˈdeɪts/
dialogue.zh: 那就避開夜間配方，它會讓你想睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. I also take thyroid meds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tu noʊ aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ teɪk ˈθaɪrɔɪ mɛdz/
dialogue.zh: 很高興知道。我也有在吃甲狀腺藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, let me check for any interactions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ lɛt mi tʃɛk fɔr ˈɛni ˌɪntərˈækʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 啊，讓我檢查有沒有交互作用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, is this one safe to mix?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ɪz ðɪs wʌn seɪf tu mɪks/
dialogue.zh: 好，這個可以跟我的藥一起吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is fine, just space them out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz faɪn dʒʌst speɪz ðɛm aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 這個沒問題，只要隔開時間吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far apart should I take them?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr əˈpɑrt ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ðɛm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About four hours between the two doses.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt fɔr ˈaʊərz bəˈtwin ðə tu doʊsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 大約間隔四個小時就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Does this help congestion fast too?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ dʌz ðɪs hɛlp kənˈdʒɛstʃən fæst tu/
dialogue.zh: 好。這個也能快速緩解鼻塞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, within thirty minutes, drink extra water.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪˈðɪn ˈθɜrdi ˈmɪnɪts drɪŋk ˈɛkstrə ˈwɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 能，三十分鐘內見效，多喝點水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I'll grab this box then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it two days; if worse, call me.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt tu deɪz ɪf wɜrs kɔl mi/
dialogue.zh: 先吃兩天；如果變嚴重，打給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do, thanks for your patience here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du θæŋks fɔr jɔr ˈpeɪʃəns hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我會的，謝謝你在這裡的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel better soon, rest and stay warm!
dialogue.phonetic: /fil ˈbɛtər sun rɛst ənd steɪ wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 祝你早日康復，多休息、注意保暖！
